style: photorealistic studio product photograph, square image. Plain warm light grey seamless studio backdrop (#E2DFD8), soft even studio lighting, soft natural contact shadow, three-quarter front-left view, the whole object in frame and filling about 80% of it. Matte black finish on painted or coated parts unless the description says otherwise; bare steel stays steel. Unbranded, no logos, no text, no numbers, no people, nothing else in the scene.
rows: cambered

A cambered squat bar: a long Olympic-length steel barbell whose centre section is straight, then drops sharply downwards about 35 cm on each side before the chrome loading sleeves, so the sleeves sit well below the centre. Unloaded, lying flat.
axle
An axle / fat bar, a thick un-knurled steel bar about 50 mm in diameter with no rotating sleeves, the whole bar the same thickness end to end, loaded with plates near each end.
fixedbb

A set of fixed-weight barbells: five short straight barbells, each with black rubber plates permanently fixed at both ends and steel end caps, the plates getting bigger bar by bar, resting horizontally on a tiered black upright rack.
landminehandle
A landmine handle: a short steel sleeve that slides onto the end of a barbell, with a pair of neutral rubber grip handles splayed in a V shape, lying on the floor on its own.
chains
A pair of lifting chains: two heavy steel link chains, each hanging from a thinner loading chain with a clip, laid on the floor in two neat piles.
fatgrips
A set of thick grips, a pair of thick rubber tubular sleeves with a slit along their length, made to clip around a bar or dumbbell handle to widen it.
heavydb
A set of heavy dumbbells (50 kg+), a rack of very large round dumbbells with thick plates welded to chunky knurled handles, the heaviest pairs at the end being much bigger than the others.
adjkb
An adjustable kettlebell, a kettlebell made of a handle and core that accepts stacked weight plates locked into its base, with a selector dial or locking pin.
clubs
A set of clubbells / Indian clubs, a pair of bowling-pin-shaped steel or wooden clubs, narrow at the knurled handle and widening to a heavy rounded end.
mace
A steel mace, a long steel bar about 1 m long with a heavy steel ball welded to one end and a knurled shaft, standing upright on the ball end.
adjdb

A set of adjustable dumbbells, a pair of adjustable dumbbells sitting in their moulded cradles, each with a handle inside a stack of nested weight plates and a selector dial or pin to choose the load.
cablerope
A triceps rope, a thick braided nylon rope folded in two with a steel snap-link ring at the centre and a rubber stopper ball at each end.
straightbar
A straight cable bar, a short knurled chrome bar about 50 cm long with a swivel mount and a clip ring in the centre for connecting to a cable.
ezcable
An EZ cable bar, a short chrome bar about 50 cm long with a zig-zag W-shaped bend, knurled grips and a central swivel clip ring for connecting to a cable.
vbar
A V-bar, a small triangular steel handle with two parallel neutral rubber-gripped handles side by side and a clip ring at the point of the V.
sledrope
A sled pull rope: a long thick black braided rope coiled loosely on the floor, with a steel carabiner on one end.
sandbag
A sandbag, a heavy cylindrical bag made of thick black cordura nylon with several side and end grab handles, stuffed tight and resting on the floor.
medball
A medicine ball: a round black rubber ball about the size of a football with a grippy textured dimpled surface, resting on the floor beside two smaller ones.
slamball
A slam ball, a heavy thick-walled black rubber ball with a ribbed, textured surface and a visible fill valve, slightly squashed where it rests on the floor.
box
A plywood plyo box: a three-height box with three different rectangular faces, made of plain plywood with a hand-hold cut-out on each side.
agility
An agility ladder: a flat black strap ladder with yellow plastic rungs laid straight on the floor, next to three small yellow plastic step-over hurdles and four orange marker cones.
sledgehammer
A sledgehammer: a 90 cm steel-shafted hammer with a black rubber grip and a heavy flat-faced steel head, lying on the floor on its own.
jumprope
A jump rope, a thin coated steel cable rope with two slim aluminium handles containing bearings, laid out in a loop on the floor.
weightvest
A weighted vest, a short tactical-style vest with front and back pockets holding flat steel weight plates, held on by wide hook-and-loop side straps.
sprintharness
A resisted sprint harness: a black padded waist belt laid on the floor with a long black nylon tether running from its back to a folded black fabric speed parachute, all laid out flat on the floor.
yoke

A yoke, a tall rectangular steel frame with two vertical uprights and a padded crossbar at shoulder height, loading horns on the lower legs and a flat base, so the user stands under the crossbar and lifts it.
farmerhandles
A set of farmer's handles, a pair of long steel bars, each with a central knurled handle raised on a frame and loading horns at each end, sitting parallel on the floor loaded with plates.
framecarry
A frame carry, a large rectangular steel frame with two long parallel side rails with handles, loading posts on each end and connecting cross members, sitting on the floor.
stones
A set of atlas stones: four round smooth grey concrete spheres of increasing size in a row on the floor.
husafell
A Husafell stone, a large flat triangular slab of stone or a cast steel equivalent shaped like a thick arrowhead, about 60 cm tall, lying flat on rubber flooring.
tyre
A tyre, a huge black tractor tyre about 1.5 m across with deep treads, lying flat on its side on the ground.
log
A log, a thick hollow steel cylinder about 30 cm across with two neutral handles cut into a recess in its middle and standard loading sleeves at each end.
circusdb
A circus dumbbell, a large single dumbbell with a very thick rotating handle about 6 cm across and two big hollow spherical heads, one with a loading port, standing on its end.
keg
A keg, a steel beer keg with two built-in side handles, weighted with sand or water, standing upright on the floor.
pullup
A pull-up bar, a straight knurled steel bar mounted horizontally above head height between two wall brackets or across the top of a rack, with angled neutral grip handles at each end.
dip
A set of dip bars, a pair of parallel steel bars about 50 cm apart and 1.2 m high on a sturdy free-standing frame, with knurled or rubber grips.
rings
A set of gymnastic rings, a pair of smooth wooden rings about 23 cm across, hanging side by side from long black webbing straps with cam buckles from an overhead beam.
trx

A suspension trainer (TRX), a single anchor strap at the top splitting into two adjustable yellow and black nylon webbing straps with rubber handles and foot cradles at the bottom, hanging from a door or bar.
anchor
A foot anchor / Nordic strap, a padded nylon strap with a foam ankle loop and a flat anchor tab that closes inside a door, alongside a low padded bar for hooking the feet under.
bands
A set of resistance bands, a set of long flat looped latex bands of different colours and widths, coiled on the floor and one hooked over a steel peg at the base of a rack.
minibands
A set of mini bands / hip circle, a set of short wide loop bands made of woven fabric with rubber grip strips, in three colours of increasing thickness, laid flat.
hangboard
A fingerboard / hangboard, a wooden or resin board mounted on a wall above a doorway, with a row of edges, pockets and slopers of various depths along its face and a jug hold at each end.
abwheel
An ab wheel, a small rubber-tyred wheel about 18 cm across with a central axle and two short foam-covered handles sticking out either side.
swissball
A stability ball, a large smooth inflated PVC ball about 65 cm across, resting on a gym floor.
parallettes
A set of parallettes, a pair of low parallel steel or wooden bars about 60 cm long on short splayed legs, set side by side on the floor.
dipbelt
A dip / weight belt, a curved padded leather or nylon belt with a heavy steel chain running from one end ring to the other with a carabiner, with a weight plate hanging on the chain.
climbrope
A climbing rope, a thick braided natural fibre rope about 4 cm across hanging vertically from a steel beam high above, reaching down to the gym floor.
pegboard
A pegboard, a tall rectangular wooden board fixed vertically to a wall, with two columns of round holes running up its length and two wooden pegs sitting in holes near the bottom.
slidder
A set of sliders, a pair of round flat plastic gliding discs about 18 cm across, with a smooth underside and a soft foam top, resting on a wooden floor.
wristroller
A wrist roller, a short knurled steel bar with a length of rope wound around its middle and a carabiner at the end of the rope holding a weight plate.
grippers
A set of grip trainers, a pair of steel torsion spring hand grippers with knurled aluminium handles, beside a small steel pinch block with a loading pin.
neckharness
A neck harness, a leather or nylon head harness with straps that go over the top and around the back of the head, joined by a short chain with a carabiner for hanging weight plates.
hangstraps
A set of hanging ab straps, a pair of padded nylon loops with steel carabiners at the top, clipped to an overhead pull-up bar so the upper arms rest in the loops and the body hangs below.
stepplat
An aerobic step, a low rectangular moulded plastic step about 1 m long with a ridged non-slip rubber top and stackable riser blocks under each end.
ankleweights
A set of ankle weights, a pair of padded fabric cuffs filled with sand or iron pellets, with hook-and-loop straps that wrap around the ankle.
monkeybars
A set of monkey bars, a horizontal steel ladder raised about 2.2 m off the ground on two A-frame supports at each end, with evenly spaced round rungs.
wallbars
A set of wall bars, a tall wooden frame about 2.4 m high fixed flat to a wall, with evenly spaced round wooden rungs running from floor to near the ceiling.
foamroller
A foam roller, a firm foam cylinder about 15 cm across and 45 cm long with a textured grid surface over a hollow plastic core, lying on a gym floor.
massageball
A massage ball, a small hard rubber ball the size of a tennis ball beside a double peanut-shaped ball made of two joined spheres.
massagegun
A massage gun, a handheld percussive massage device shaped like a hairdryer, with a rubber grip handle, a motor body and a round foam head on a short shaft.
yogamat
An exercise / yoga mat, a thin rectangular rubber exercise mat about 180 cm long, partly rolled up at one end, lying flat on a wooden floor.
dowel
A PVC pipe / dowel, a straight lightweight white PVC pipe or wooden dowel about 1.5 m long and 3 cm thick, lying on a gym floor.
stretchstrap
A set of stretch strap, a long flat nylon webbing strap with a series of sewn loops along its length for the hands and feet.
slantboard
A slant board, a flat wooden board about 40 cm wide raised at the back to a steep incline of 20 to 30 degrees on fixed legs, with grip tape covering the top surface.
balanceboard
A balance / wobble board, a round flat wooden disc about 40 cm across with a half-sphere pivot underneath it so it tilts in all directions, with a grip surface on top.
bosu
A BOSU ball, a large inflated half-sphere of blue rubber about 60 cm across fixed to a flat rigid black plastic base with two handles cut into its rim.
